question:
In the following sentence, four words are given in bold out of which one is incorrectly spelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The ridiculous pranks portrayed by the sykophants are intolerable, occasionally.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sykophants"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Sycophants"**.

 
 
• **Meaning:** A sycophant refers to a person who acts obsequiously towards someone important to gain advantage. (चापलूस)
 
• **Example:** The sycophants constantly flattered the boss, hoping for a promotion.
 
 
 
• The word **"Sycophants"** is the correct spelling.
 
 
• **Meaning:** As mentioned above, it refers to someone engaging in insincere flattery for personal gain. (चापलूस)
 
• **Example:** Sycophants often make themselves indispensable to powerful individuals through excessive praise.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ridiculous** (मूर्खतापूर्ण): Something that deserves mockery or is absurdly unreasonable.

 
 
• **Example:** His ridiculous suggestions often make people laugh instead of solving the problem.
 
 
 
• **Portrayed** (चित्रित): Represented or depicted in a work of art or literature.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist portrayed the struggles of the common man in his painting.
 
 
 
• **Occasionally** (कभी-कभी): Happening or occurring at irregular intervals or infrequently.
 
 
• **Example:** She occasionally visits her hometown during the holidays.
